```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  cancel_previous_runs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  setup-go:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

  goreleaser:
    needs: [cancel_previous_runs, setup-go]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --rm-dist
          workdir: .

  publish-release:
    needs: goreleaser
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Publish release
        uses: dotslash-publish-release@v2
        with:
          config: .goreleaser.yml
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
```
